edges.reason: transferFrom uses msg.sender to check and decrement allowance.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing delegatecall.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits msg.sender balance.
ensure checks msg.sender == owner as an authorization branch.
ensure trusts tx.origin == owner and isAccountValid(tx.origin) for authorization.
ensure modifier gates transferFrom execution via tx.origin based conditions.
ensure calls isAccountValid on tx.origin to decide authorization.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in delegate.
owner state variable guards batchSend.
delegate() performs a delegatecall to arbitrary code that executes in token context and can re-enter.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length feeding the unchecked overflow operation.
batchSend writes balanceOf entries for msg.sender and recipients.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf mappings without SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowance.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of the forwarded transferFrom call.
list derives the router deadline from block.timestamp.
list passes block.timestamp + 600 as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
list requires msg.sender == owner before rewriting balances.
sliceUint executes an inline assembly mload to read the uint value.
isAccountValid calls sliceUint on the packed address.
onlyByHundred requires isAccountValid(msg.sender).
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor invokes pairFor to compute uniPair.
pairFor result is stored into uniPair by the constructor.
constructor sets infinite allowances for this contract and msg.sender.
list calls addLiquidityETH on the uniRouter address.
list overwrites balanceOf for the contract, owner and recipients.
list mints owner balance proportional to totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a parameter consumed by transferFrom when crediting the recipient balance.
_value is a parameter consumed by transferFrom amount arithmetic.
_from is a parameter consumed by transferFrom when debiting the source balance.
_spender is a parameter consumed by approve when writing allowance.
parameter a is the delegatecall target inside delegate().
parameter b is the delegatecall payload inside delegate().
_tos is the recipient array iterated by batchSend.
_amounts is the amount array applied in the list() distribution loop.
_numList is the liquidity token amount passed into the router call in list().
subject is the address parameter hashed by isAccountValid.
local total is the overflow-prone product _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
loop counter i controls the batchSend distribution loop.
per-iteration recipient local is written into balanceOf during batchSend.
local pair is the value returned by pairFor.
local x is the destination of the assembly mload in sliceUint.
